diagnostics.selectionIntent: An available cancellation token is not propagated to a call that accepts one.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Pass the CancellationToken that is already in scope to the callee overload that accepts one.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Only fires when a token is in scope and a token-accepting overload is visible; it does not reason about tokens stored on fields or captured indirectly.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A blocking operation is used inside an async method.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Await the asynchronous equivalent instead of blocking with .Result, .Wait(), or GetAwaiter().GetResult().
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Recognises a fixed set of known blocking members; blocking hidden behind a helper method is not detected.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A resource's lifetime ends before the associated asynchronous work completes.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Await the asynchronous work before the using scope or disposal that owns the resource ends.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Targets specific patterns such as awaiting after a using block; it is not a general lifetime analysis.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: An async result is not observed in a context where it should be awaited.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Await the returned task or explicitly capture and observe it.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Scope is limited to supported contexts defined by the upstream rule; deliberate fire-and-forget wrappers are not always distinguishable.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A task-returning method returns null instead of a completed task.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Return Task.CompletedTask, Task.FromResult(...), or an actual task rather than null.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Detects literal null returns and simple flows; null produced through indirection may be missed.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: The ThreadStatic attribute is applied to an instance field.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: ThreadStatic only affects static fields; make the field static or remove the attribute.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Purely an attribute-placement check.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A re-wrapped exception loses its original exception chain.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Pass the caught exception as the innerException argument when throwing a new exception.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Recognises common re-wrap shapes inside catch blocks; unusual control flow may not be covered.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A regular expression is evaluated without a timeout in the rule's supported cases.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Supply a matchTimeout, or use a source-generated or precompiled regex with a bounded timeout.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Covers direct Regex construction and static Regex calls in supported forms; it does not assess whether a given pattern is actually vulnerable to catastrophic backtracking.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: An owned disposable object may be left undisposed on some path.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Dispose the object on all paths, typically with a using declaration or try/finally.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Dataflow-based and conservative; ownership transferred to a caller or field can produce false positives, and it can miss disposal errors behind complex flow.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A ValueTask is consumed incorrectly, for example awaited or read more than once.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Await a ValueTask exactly once, or convert it with AsTask() before storing or reusing it.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Flags known misuse shapes; indirection through locals or helper methods can hide a violation.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: Re-throwing the caught exception object discards the original stack trace.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Use throw; to preserve the original stack, or wrap with a new exception that carries the caught one as innerException.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Only the direct throw ex; pattern inside a catch clause is detected.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A supported certificate-validation bypass pattern accepts any server certificate.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Do not return true unconditionally from a certificate validation callback; validate the chain and errors.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Recognises specific callback shapes that always accept; it is not comprehensive TLS or transport security analysis.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A cancellation-token overload is available but the call does not use it.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Use the overload that accepts a CancellationToken when cancellation belongs in the calling flow.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: This is a candidate for adding cancellation support, not proof that every operation needs a token; fixed framework contracts and pure computation may be legitimate exceptions.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: An awaitable-returning method does not use the Async suffix.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Add the Async suffix unless an override, interface contract, entry point, or established framework convention fixes the name.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Naming is contextual; overrides, interface implementations, entry points, and framework conventions can be legitimate exceptions handled by the upstream analyzer.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: An async lambda is converted to a void-returning delegate.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Use a Task-returning delegate so callers can await completion and observe failures.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Event-style callback APIs may require void-returning delegates; review the owning API contract before changing it.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A method uses async void.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Return Task so callers can await completion and observe exceptions.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Event handlers and framework callbacks can legitimately require void and are still reported in supported shapes; those cases need review and may require explicit suppression.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: Project-wide nullable warning analysis is not enabled.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Set Nullable to enable or warnings in an imported props file or the project.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Checks the evaluated project-wide setting for the selected configuration and target framework; local #nullable directives are outside this check.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: SDK analyzers or analyzer execution during build are explicitly disabled.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Remove the disabling override or enable .NET analyzers and analyzer execution during build.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Checks evaluated SDK properties for the selected configuration and target framework; it does not prove every CI command runs analyzers.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: Compiler and analyzer warnings are not comprehensively treated as build errors.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Enable TreatWarningsAsErrors and avoid broad warning exemptions; do not disable CodeAnalysisTreatWarningsAsErrors.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Checks the selected configuration only; selective WarningsAsErrors promotion is reported as partial policy rather than treated as comprehensive enforcement.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: Code-style diagnostics are not enforced during build.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Set EnforceCodeStyleInBuild to true in shared build configuration.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Checks the evaluated build setting, not which individual style rules are enabled or suppressed.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: Central Package Management is not enabled.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Enable ManagePackageVersionsCentrally in Directory.Packages.props when centralized dependency governance is appropriate.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: This is an optional governance recommendation; a repository can manage package versions consistently without Central Package Management.

diagnostics.selectionIntent: A restored NuGet package, direct or transitive, has a published vulnerability advisory.
diagnostics.shortGuidance: Upgrade the package to a version outside the advisory range, or add a direct pinned reference to a fixed version.
diagnostics.knownLimitations: Runs only with --audit. Reports the existence of a published advisory for a resolved package; it does not assess whether the vulnerable code path is reachable in the application. Feed freshness is only as current as the SDK's advisory data.
